profile.headline: Full Stack Developer | UX/UI Design | Web Design & Developer
profile.summary:
With over three years of experience in web development and user experience design, I am a Storefront Administrator at The John Roberts Company, where I manage and maintain the online store and its features. I am skilled in HTML, CSS, Javascript, PHP, and Shopify, and I have developed various websites for different purposes and audiences, such as e-learning, e-commerce, and education.

I am passionate about creating user-friendly, accessible, and beautiful web solutions that solve real problems and meet user needs. I have a background in human-centered computing and I apply user research, wireframing, usability testing, and design principles to my projects. I also collaborate with cross-functional teams and stakeholders to deliver high-quality products and services. My goal is to learn and contribute to the technology space with my design and web development skills.

positions.title: Owner
positions.description:
Designing and developing visually appealing and user-friendly websites across diverse industries.
    Implementing custom Google Apps Script solutions to automate business processes, streamline data management, and enhance efficiency.
    Conducting usability testing and implementing UX best practices, resulting in a 20% increase in user engagement.
    Providing ongoing website maintenance, updates, and technical support for optimal performance.

positions.title: Storefront Administrator
positions.locationName: Coon Rapids, Minnesota, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
- Managed partner e-commerce platforms, overseeing 1,000+ product listings and reducing customer inquiries by 30%.
- Collaborated with the marketing team to execute online campaigns and promotions.
- Implemented security measures to protect customer information and ensure GDPR compliance.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
- Designed and developed complete Shopify e-commerce websites, resulting in a 15% increase in conversion rates.
- Implemented automation scripts to streamline tasks, reducing fulfillment wait time by 300%.
- Developed and introduced a tagging system for orders, improving order fulfillment efficiency.

positions.title: User Experience Designer
positions.description: Analyzed user needs and proposed design solutions. delivered wireframes, graphic mockups, and storyboards. assisted in implementing ui/ux improvements of digital product interfaces. Created a user manual for the rugged dash system, resulting in a 30% decrease in user support requests.

positions.title: Web Developer / Program Analyst
positions.description: I migrated data to various applications, built webpages, and corrected current applications. I proofed data listings and diagrams, adding them to the database for operations and customer use—assisted management on the operations side of the business with customer service and online support.

positions.title: Webmaster
positions.description: Develops websites for Sigma Chi Fraternities main events, maintaining and updating of pre-existing websites, database, and technologies, using HTML, CSS, Javascript, and PHP. Tasked with a major project to redesign an outdated website to increase unique visitors and meet accessibility standards.

positions.title: Private Tutor (Higher Education Opportunity Program)
positions.description: The Arthur O. Eve Higher Education Opportunity Program (HEOP) is a partnership between the State of New York and its independent colleges which provides economically and educationally disadvantaged residents the possibility of a college education. The primary objective of HEOP is to help provide a broad range of services to the student, who because of academic and economic circumstances, would otherwise be unable to attend college, yet has the potential and desire to obtain a college degree. HEOP is sponsored jointly by the State Education Department and the College. HEOP is funded jointly by participating colleges and the New York State Arthur O. Eve Higher Education Opportunity Program and programming activities are supported, in part, by a grant from the New York State Education Department.

positions.title: IS Support Technician
positions.description: Served as on-site support and was responsible for daily field support tasks, such as: imaging, maintaining device inventory, and configured software such as Imprivata, Adobe and use for Active Directory for staff. Assisted on several large projects to organize departments technology areas.

positions.title: E-Commence Web Designer
positions.description: Manage all online activity in relation to traffic acquisition, sales, conversion, and a/b testing and reporting. Develop and implement eCommerce strategy in order to improve website performance Research market in order to discover new trends and technologies in order to improve website performance

volunteerExperiences.description: Served as a snowboard instructor for deaf and hard-of-hearing students.

projects.title: Accessible Fitness Guided Program
projects.description: Studied the accessibility in group fitness classes and developed a content management platform that delivers guided workouts. The goal is to provide a solution to fitness instructors leading a workout class and make the overall gym experience more comfortable and provide a new way of accessibility.

projects.title: Pirate Toy Fund Website Redesign
projects.description: I was elected project manager for a team of seven, two members from Croatia. I streamlined project logistics for developing a solution to manage a database to organize over 10,000 toys and redesigned the website to be informative and consistent throughout physical and digital advertisements.
